adminUrl.title: Conversation page in your admin
adminUrl.description: With {conversationId}, for example https://admin.example.com/inbox?conversation={conversationId} (the inbox widget opens the conversation named by ?conversation= in its page address). Alerts link to it.

recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.description: Email addresses and international phone numbers (+ or 00 first; phones get the channel below). Name a channel first to choose it for one person: sms:+15550100, whatsapp:+15550100, email:ops@example.com, or push:<Accounts user id> for staff push. The assigned person is added.

frequency.title: New message alerts
frequency.description: First unanswered: once until staff reply or open the chat. Every message: on every visitor message.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: inbox.reply: every unblocked Accounts user whose role may reply in the inbox; all_staff: every unblocked Accounts user whose role may see the inbox (inbox.read). Both need the Accounts token. Empty = only the list above.

phoneChannel.title: Phones get
phoneChannel.description: SMS goes out with Chat's default words; WhatsApp needs your own template approved at Meta (Notifications, Settings → Templates).

staffPush.title: Staff push too
staffPush.description: Accounts staff (and the assigned person) also get a push in their browser (Notifications: Staff push, with your push keys).

maxRecipients.title: People per alert
maxRecipients.description: At most this many people get one alert (the list first, then staff and the assigned person).

includePhone.title: Alerts carry the visitor's phone
includePhone.description: Adds the value {phone} (the phone the visitor signed in with or left) to the new message and Chat needs you alerts.
